questions.question: Discuss the three pillars of sustainable development.
questions.solution_html:
• Sustainable development is based on three main pillars that must be balanced to ensure
  • long-term well-being for people and the planet. These pillars are
  •  Economic Sustainability: Focuses on maintaining economic growth and development
  • without causing harm to the environment or society. Ensures that resources are used
  • efficiently and responsibly to support livelihoods and economic activities over time.
  •  Environmental Sustainability: Involves protecting natural resources and ecosystems to
  • maintain the health of the planet. Aims to reduce pollution, conserve biodiversity, and
  • manage natural resources so they are available for future generations.
  •  Social Sustainability: Emphasizes social equity, justice, and the well-being of
  • communities. Ensures access to basic needs such as education, healthcare, and human
  • rights, promoting inclusive and resilient societies.
questions.final_answer: rights, promoting inclusive and resilient societies
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Illustrate the role of water efficient fixtures in attaining SDGs.
questions.solution_html:
• Water-efficient fixtures (low-flow toilets, faucet aerators, showerheads) reduce indoor
  • water use by up to 55%, directly advancing SDG 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation).

  • heating/treatment (SDG 13/7), and promote sustainable urban infrastructure (SDG 11).

questions.question: Describe the strategies and policies for sustainable development.
questions.solution_html:
• Sustainable development principles combine social, economic, and environmental goals
  • to promote global well-being. They aim to provide quality education, healthcare, and
  • employment while preserving ecosystems and protecting all forms of life. These
  • principles are enshrined in the UN's 17 Sustainable Development Goals
  •  Protecting the natural environment and ecosystems
  •  Safeguarding global biodiversity and species variety
  •  Promoting inclusive and long-term societal progress
  •  Enhancing and preserving human capital through health and education
  •  Regulating population growth for resource balance
  • Strategies for Sustainable Development
